hero.filename: Andrew and Mary Leon Memorial Headstone, Martyn Street Cemetery, Cairns, 2020.jpg
hero.caption: The Leon Memorial headstone was installed to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Andrew Leon's death on 27 June 1920. His wife Mary died on 22 June 1922. Leon pioneered the Cairns area sugar industry with the Hap Wah plantation (1878-1886) and was a leader of Cairns early Chinese community from the 1870s into the 1890s. The Chinese writing translates as "Centenary anniversity of death, Cairns Chinese community leader and cane sugar industry pioneer"
hero.alt: The Leon Memorial headstone was installed to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Andrew Leon's death on 27 June 1920. His wife Mary died on 22 June 1922. images.caption: Chinatown Cairns, circa 1890. The Crown Hotel (35 Shields Street) is  in the upper right of the photo. The street from left to right in front of the hotel was Sachs Street (now Grafton Street). The street running up to the right of the hotel is Shields Street. To the left of the hotel there is a building with 4 hortizontal gables with a flagpole in front, which is the Lit Sung Goong Temple (now 95 Grafton Street). The photo was taken from the roof of the Hides Hotel (87 Lakes Steet).

images.caption: I'm a tourist and and I want beer but I am a stranger in this land. Turns out Woolworth's behind from where I was staying was having sale. Buy 6 bottles and save 20%. So I told the clerk I wanted some good Aussie beer but was clueless and asked him to pick some out and this is what I ended up with.  I liked the XXXX Gold and the VB best and ordered them for the rest of the trip.
